Re-seed anytime via 'python /app/backend/tests/_iter37_seed.py' (uses fixed prices) or the live-price snippet in the report notes. Note: a concurrently running test suite called POST /api/analytics/clear (range=hour, scope=all) and deleted 2 of the 3 seed trades mid-run (audit_log 16:40:08); they were re-seeded and are open again. Also one engine-created paper trade (BTCUSDT-<ts>) is open, so BTC currently shows 3 badges (2 TEST + 1 real) - expected, not a bug.

rca_of_the_issue: Original badge bug root cause (already fixed by dev agent): openTrades state was only replaced when the trade fetch for the new symbol resolved, so the previous coin's badges stayed rendered. Fix verified: useTradeMarkers clears openTrades/counts/pin synchronously on symbol change (lastSymbolRef) and MainChart additionally filters with sameSymbol(); no stale badge observed either immediately (~0.8s) after switching or after 5s.
